window.rule: requested maximum horizon of 3 days from the observation time; games tipping off on or after 2026-11-19T15:30:00Z are outside the window

basis.away_home_rule: The schedule PDF prints two team cells and, on rows 215-259, prints no 'at' or 'vs' token between them. The away/home reading is therefore taken from the official injury report's matchup code (AWAY@HOME) when that report prints the same game, from the printed 'at' token where one exists (rows 260-269), and is otherwise corroborated by the games-page slug (away-vs-home) and left flagged.

games_page_corroboration.rule: the schedule extraction published on main is the file of record; the games-page fields are added alongside it, and no printed value in it is overwritten

extraction_notes: The PDF text carries the column header "LOCAL | ET" (read 2026-11-16 from chunks 1 and 2 of the PDF text). The first time column (tip_et_col1) is the local tip time at the home venue and the second (tip_et_col2) is Eastern time. Checked for all 25 window rows: the Eastern value equals the home venue's local time converted to ET in 25 of 25 rows. This is a consistency check against venue time zones, not a statement taken from the document; both values stay verbatim.

The extracted PDF text prints no "at" token on rows 215-259 (11/10 to 11/18) while rows 260 onward print "at"; re-confirmed on the 2026-11-16 fetch (matches pass 6/7 finding, flag P7-02). Away/home order on rows 245-259 is therefore shown only where an independent source agrees: the 11/16 10:00 AM injury report prints matchup codes for all 8 games of 11/16 (rows 245-252) and all 5 games of 11/17 (rows 253-257), and the games page prints an away-vs-home slug for every window row. Rows 260-269 print "at" in the schedule itself.

Corroboration (checked 2026-11-16): the 10:00 AM injury report prints 13 matchup codes that match window rows one-for-one - ORL@BOS, CHI@CLE, MEM@WAS, PHI@BKN, HOU@MIA, POR@MIN, GSW@NOP, PHX@DEN (11/16) and NYK@TOR, DET@SAS, POR@MIN, UTA@LAC, CHA@LAL (11/17). The report's Game Time values equal the schedule's ET column on 11 of 13 rows and disagree on exactly rows 256 and 257, where the report agrees with the games page against the schedule (see tip_disagreement on those rows). Rows 258-269 (11/18) have no independent report code because the report does not yet list 11/18 games; their order rests on the printed 'at' token (260-269) or printed order plus slug (258-259).

Four tip conflicts are kept as printed on both sides: rows 256 and 257 (games page and injury report versus the August schedule PDF) and rows 266 and 267 (games page versus the August schedule PDF). No printed value was overwritten and no time was averaged; each row carries tip_disagreement with both values.
Out-of-window follow-on rows 270-273 (11/19) were read but are excluded: the earliest 11/19 tip (8:00 PM ET = 2026-11-20T00:00Z) falls after the window end of 2026-11-19T15:30:00Z.
No venue, broadcast-independent status, odds, probability or pick is present in this file or taken from the PDF.
